description: MDC students excited to work and help with NASA problems.
summary: We developed a website that stores all of the astronauts health information in one place. We also have a VR part of the website where the astronauts can simulate places from home/on Earth to help combat any mental health issues being away from friends and family may cause. The last big feature we have is our AI assistant Carlitos who can help the astronauts in the case of an emergency and the time delays to Earth are too long to wait.
details: AstroCare is a website designed to work offline with preloaded data that NASA and the flight surgeons give to give a baseline and keep track of the health of the astronauts based on the five hazards of human space flight. Carlitos is the AI that will help and determine if there is anything wrong and can also explain to the astronauts any questions they may have in the case that the 20 minute communication delay is too long to wait. The emergency button is designed to guide the astronauts through any emergency they may have and give them NASA approved steps on what to do and how to solve it with the preloaded data uploaded. All information is designed to be inputted into the website however the implementation of using already established NASA technology to record automatically into the site should be considered for future use. The VR design will use rooms that are already downloaded and simulate someplace on Earth, preferably chosen one scene per astronaut at the minimum, to help the astronauts combat any loneliness or homesickness they may feel on the mission. The intended impact is to help the astronauts have a neat system to keep all of their data and help them understand any problems they may have as well.
